  <script type="text/markdown">
# Kit MD: render e hydratación

Títulos con **color de marca**. Inline mono, bloques con theme, fences iswc-* y HTML is-*.

## 1. Código

Inline sin fondo: `ensure`, `loader.has`, `brand-mono`. Chip {{tono}}.

### JavaScript

```js
const L = globalThis.ISWebComponentsLoader;
await L.loadCSSBase();
await L.load("iswc-md-render");
const saludo = (nombre) => `Hola ${nombre}`;
```

### TypeScript

```ts
type SkillDoc = { label: string; url: string };
export function collect(docs: SkillDoc[]): string[] {
  return docs.map((d) => d.url).filter(Boolean);
}
```

### HTML / CSS

```html
<iswc-button color="brand" size="sm">Acción</iswc-button>
```

```css
:host {
  --_brand: var(--iswc-color-brand, #339af0);
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--_brand) 72%, var(--iswc-text));
}
```

## 2. Diagramas (fences iswc)

### Flowchart

```iswc-flowchart
{
  "flowchart": {
    "title": "Alta rápida",
    "direction": "LR",
    "nodes": [
      {
        "id": "a",
        "label": "Inicio",
        "shape": "stadium"
      },
      {
        "id": "b",
        "label": "Validar"
      },
      {
        "id": "c",
        "label": "¿Ok?",
        "shape": "diamond"
      },
      {
        "id": "d",
        "label": "Fin",
        "shape": "stadium"
      }
    ],
    "edges": [
      {
        "from": "a",
        "to": "b"
      },
      {
        "from": "b",
        "to": "c"
      },
      {
        "from": "c",
        "to": "d",
        "label": "sí"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Sequence

```iswc-sequence
{
  "sequence": {
    "title": "Auth",
    "actors": [
      {
        "id": "U",
        "label": "User",
        "kind": "actor"
      },
      {
        "id": "A",
        "label": "API",
        "kind": "participant"
      }
    ],
    "messages": [
      {
        "from": "U",
        "to": "A",
        "label": "POST /auth"
      },
      {
        "from": "A",
        "to": "U",
        "label": "JWT",
        "kind": "return"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Mindmap

```iswc-mindmap
{
  "mindmap": {
    "title": "MD kit",
    "layout": "tree",
    "nodes": [
      {
        "id": "root",
        "label": "iswc-md-*",
        "hue": 210
      },
      {
        "id": "a",
        "parent": "root",
        "label": "render",
        "hue": 199
      },
      {
        "id": "b",
        "parent": "root",
        "label": "editor",
        "hue": 160
      },
      {
        "id": "c",
        "parent": "root",
        "label": "hydrate",
        "hue": 38
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## 3. HTML del kit

<iswc-button color="brand" size="sm">Guardar</iswc-button>
<iswc-button color="neutral" variant="soft" size="sm">Cancelar</iswc-button>

<iswc-tag color="brand" size="sm">lazy</iswc-tag>
<iswc-tag color="success" size="sm">hydrate</iswc-tag>

## 4. Tabla + lista + cita

| Contenido | Qué pasa |
| --- | --- |
| `x` inline | iswc-code brand-mono, sin fondo |
| fence js/ts/html/css | iswc-code theme dark/light |
| fence iswc-flowchart | iswc-flowchart readonly |
| iswc-button HTML | ensure iswc-button |

1. md-lite marca fences / inline
2. `ensure` solo tags necesarios
3. Upgrade a iswc-code / diagramas

> Solo hechos verificables. El loader no duplica módulos.

---

Enlace: [skills CDN](https://github.com/Jeff-Aporta/is-webcomponents).
  </script>
</iswc-md-editor>
